description: This PHP class defines a console command 'MailingCommand' for handling mass email sending within the Goteo application. It manages configuration, execution flow, process control, and quota checks for sending bulk emails.

classes.name: MailingCommand
classes.description: A console command class for managing bulk email campaigns, including configuration, process control, quota management, and process spawning for sending emails.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command name, description, arguments, options, and help text.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main execution method that handles the logic for sending bulk emails, including quota checks, locking, process management, and error handling.
